reproduction: All current native diagnostic and ablation artifacts, prediction vectors, source bindings, complete programs, frozen sources and drivers are retained. Two failed initialization projects precede successful zero-API recovery; they performed no fits. Six diagnostic fits and two successive48-fit ablations used normal native CPU actions, no provider calls. For historical reuse-study context and optional preparation replay, the preceding complete archive is indexed at docs/evidence/runs/2026-09-17-research-reuse/private-evidence.json. Published drivers use absolute original ROOT; replay requires a separate fresh project directory, deliberate path remapping and source refreezing, not rerunning original open-x stages. Analyze archived results without paid replay. This archive does not duplicate the entire preceding study.
